sentences.wiring_vs_shuffle: On the first of 5 seeds, the fly's wiring and its degree-preserving shuffle reproduced the DTI engine equally well: composite error 1.58 vs 1.53 points (difference -0.06), tier agreement 0.880 vs 0.876.
sentences.wiring_vs_random_and_matched_network: The random graph at matched density matched the fly on tier agreement (0.875 vs 0.880) and composite error (1.82 vs 1.58 points); all three fixed graphs beat the same-size trained network (3.73 points, 0.842).
sentences.model_arms_beside_fly: Four models given the DTI paper and 300 of the same records matched the engine's tier on 20% (Claude Opus 5) to 45% (Gemini 3 Flash), at 13 s to 73 s and $0.04 to $0.26 per record. The fly, same records: 84%, 16 ms, $0 marginal.
sentences.bii: BII, under the seed policy with empty registries: the fly's score error 0.0288 and gate agreement 0.914 on 4,000 synthetic windows.
